description: This file defines the PersonalizeEventsClient class used to interact with the Amazon Personalize Events service in the AWS SDK for PHP. It includes method annotations for various asynchronous and synchronous operations related to interactions, actions, events, items, and users.

classes.name: PersonalizeEventsClient
classes.description: A client class for the Amazon Personalize Events service, extending AwsClient to provide specific methods for the service.

methods.name: putActionInteractions
methods.description: Sends a batch of action interactions to the Personalize Events service.

methods.name: putActionInteractionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a batch of action interactions.

methods.name: putActions
methods.description: Sends a batch of actions to the service.

methods.name: putActionsAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a batch of actions.
